value: Core mission: reduced token usage via local knowledge interactions — get/set/find against the store instead of re-exploring the codebase — and the seed concept ([[conventions.seedDensity]]): entries activate pretrained knowledge rather than store it. Every session starts with full context; every insight gets stored for the next. As the store grows, hit rates improve and agents spend fewer tokens exploring — tracked via per-period trends in reverie_stats. Every feature and convention should be judged against this mission.
